Log to a date-stamped rotating file

Source: R/Appender.R
AppenderFileRotatingDate.Rd

This is a simpler version of AppenderFileRotatingTime when the timestamps do not need to include sub-day accuracy.

See also

AppenderFileRotatingTime, AppenderFileRotating, rotor::rotate()

Other Appenders: Appender, AppenderBuffer, AppenderConsole, AppenderFile, AppenderFileRotating, AppenderFileRotatingTime, AppenderTable

AppenderFileRotatingDate$new()

Create a new AppenderFileRotatingDate.

Usage

AppenderFileRotatingDate$new(
  file,
  threshold = NA_integer_,
  layout = LayoutFormat$new(),
  filters = NULL,
  age = Inf,
  size = -1,
  max_backups = Inf,
  compression = FALSE,
  backup_dir = dirname(file),
  fmt = "%Y-%m-%d",
  overwrite = FALSE,
  cache_backups = TRUE,
  create_file = NULL
)

Arguments

file

character scalar. Path to the log file. If file does not exist it will be created.

threshold

character or integer scalar. The minimum log level that triggers this Appender. See log_levels.

layout

A Layout that determines how LogEvents are formatted before being output by this Appender.

filters

A list of EventFilters or predicate functions used to filter events for this Appender. See Filterable.

age, size, max_backups, compression, backup_dir, fmt, overwrite, cache_backups

see rotor::rotate_date() for the meaning of these arguments. Note that backup_dir corresponds to dir.

create_file

Defunct, do not use.
